# Laya Document Summariser

Summarises long documents (Word, PDF, PowerPoint) at the length you need, with every point linked to its section or page so you can check it. Compares two versions and explains what changed, and pulls out actions, deadlines, obligations and figures.

**Who can use it:** everyone, on free Copilot Chat or the paid licence.

## What to upload

The document(s) - Word, PDF or PowerPoint. Two files to compare versions.

## What you get

A summary at the length you choose, with each point referenced to its section or page; or a table of what changed between versions; or a list of actions and deadlines.

## Example

Upload last year's and this year's version of a policy and ask "What changed?" You get a table of changes ranked by importance, with before-and-after wording.

## Try saying

- *Can you summarise this document for me?*
- *I have two versions of a document. What changed between them?*
- *What actions and deadlines are in this document?*

## Tips

- Say who the summary is for, and how long it should be.
- For contracts or regulatory documents, check the original wording before acting.
